params.body:
The README was the Hugo starter's "My Blog README". This one says what the repo itself says: what the site carries (blog, five explainers, about; the redirect stubs), the stack (Hugo extended 0.155.2 pinned in ci.yml, the hugo-paper submodule, Tailwind with the built main.css committed, the signing libraries), the layout including the did:webvh log under static/.well-known that signs the posts, how to run, sign and screenshot it with the scripts from package.json, what the tests check (they build the site and look at what a visitor gets), the three workflows, and how it deploys: not from this repo but from a cron on the server that pulls main, builds, and writes /.well-known/build.json for Elixir.

Left in as facts the repo carries: there is no elixir.json here, and tools/vault points at a path outside the repo. claude.md still describes a Living Book that no longer exists in content or layouts; that is for a separate change.

Proposed through the control gateway under #agent-workbench.
params.title: README: what the repo says about itself
